page.layout: One page of text in a decorative woodcut border; running head with page number at top. Printed text only in the central block. Right edge shows show-through from the facing page and a digitiser's notice at the bottom, which are left out.

main_text.p: ram Lapidis sui universalem cultro, & indidem eodem modo extracto, tantūq; absterso cum papyro super liquatum aurum projecta, etiamsi prorsus nihil adhaesisse videatur cultro, solo odore tamen Tincturæ suæ unciam plumbi integram in aurum converterint omni specillo probatum, ut retulerunt nobis, qui viderunt, quorum animi cum essent antea ab hoc studio prorsus alieni, facti sunt posteaartis avidissimi.

Sed unicuiq; (inquit Basilius) qui huic sapientiæ adhæret, eamq; amare cupit, incumbit, ut aureum illum magnetem (videlicet Universalis universalissimi) pervestiget, quò rectius eum agnoscat, quem unicain re unicè, & in una sola materia radicem ejus inveniet (quâ cum
Note text not legible at this scan resolution.

page.notes: The last line of the printed text is a catchword ending "cum". Marginal notes are not printed on this page. The bottom of the page is blank apart from the border. The side notes on the right edge belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Some passages in the italic block are only partly legible and may contain errors.
